day2_intro.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
day2_intro.text: Oi unc, you reckon you could sell some of these hoons? Boss is tryna find suppliers, ay.

boss_info.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
boss_info.text: Don't worry 'bout names... we're part of the Gumboot Gang. Boss runs things, keeps it tight. He wants these hoons moved fast, and we need someone we can trust.

incentive.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
incentive.text: Cash, bro. Easy money. You sell the hoons, we look after ya. Mean deal, ay?

decline.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
decline.text: Fair enough. Offers still on the table. I'll swing by tomorrow and see what you decide.

leave.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
leave.text: Shot bro, I'll come back tomorrow. Keep it hush hush, ay.

day3_intro.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
day3_intro.text: Hey unc, about those hoons... you gonna sell them or what?

selling_hoons.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
selling_hoons.text: Sweettt. Hey, I got to get into the club tomorrow but I'm underage. You reckon you could start selling Fake IDs?

not_selling.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
not_selling.text: What?? Boss ain't gonna like this... You're all goods man, stay safe

accept_fakeids.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
accept_fakeids.text: Alright man, well I gotta gap. Stay safe unc!

day4_intro.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
day4_intro.text: Hey man, you got the Fake IDs?

ids_ready.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
ids_ready.text: Sweettt, thanks m'bro, I appreciate it. Hey, I also heard the big boss was planning to ram raid local dairys. But don't worry man, I'll make sure you're not on the list. Just continue selling boss's stock and you'll be fine.

day4_no_ids.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
day4_no_ids.text: No IDs yet? Alright... just remember, boss likes people who deliver.

day5_intro.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
day5_intro.text: Hey... look, I usually don't say this stuff but you looked out for me the other day. Word is the boys are planning a ram raid soon. I don't want you getting hurt, so... just thought you should know.

raid_warning.speaker: Tane "Big Lad" Moana
raid_warning.text: I can't tell you anymore than this, sorry. Stay safe unc.
